name: Colombia
headline_status: Colombia allows adults to carry a personal dose of up to 20 g and grow up to 20 plants, and has a licensed medical cannabis industry, but recreational sales are illegal.
summary: Colombia has long permitted a personal dose of up to 20 g of cannabis and home growing of up to 20 plants for personal use, while commercial production and sale for recreational use remain crimes. A licensed medical and CBD industry operates under authorisations from the ministries of Justice and Health, with products approved by INVIMA. A constitutional reform to legalise an adult-use market cleared several debates but was shelved by the Senate on 12 December 2023.

possession_limit.value: A personal dose of up to 20 g is legal.

home_grow.value: Up to 20 plants for personal consumption; home-grown cannabis may not be processed or sold.

retail_sales.value: No recreational sales; commercial production, import and export for recreational use are prohibited.

medical_program.value: Growing, selling and importing medical cannabis is allowed under licence; patients access pharmaceutical products rather than raw flower, and THC may only be an active ingredient in medicines.

regulator.value: Ministry of Justice (cultivation licences), Ministry of Health (processing licences), ICA (agricultural approvals) and INVIMA (finished-product approval).

penalties.value: Consumption itself is not punished, but recreational production and trade are criminal offences. A December 2023 presidential decree removed the fine for possessing small amounts and police power to seize them.

hemp_thc.value: Non-psychoactive (CBD) cannabis may be used in cosmetics, dietary supplements and pharmaceuticals.

tourists.value: Visitors may carry a personal dose like residents, but there is no legal place to buy recreational cannabis.

timeline.event: Lower house rejects an earlier constitutional amendment to allow adult recreational use
Senate First Committee approves adult-use cannabis constitutional reform
Senate shelves the adult-use reform, forcing the process to restart

faq.a: Partly. Adults may carry up to 20 g and grow up to 20 plants for personal use, but selling recreational cannabis is illegal.

faq.q: Can tourists smoke weed in Colombia?
faq.a: Visitors can carry a personal dose like residents, but there are no legal shops, so buying is illegal.

faq.q: Is medical cannabis legal in Colombia?
faq.a: Yes. Licensed companies grow and process cannabis for medical products, which must be approved by INVIMA.
